deployment_assumptions.name: finite_attention_values
deployment_assumptions.scope: Every V lane consumed by a reachable deployed attention dot is finite; unused cache-pool storage is irrelevant.

deployment_assumptions.name: cuda_graph_replay_fidelity
deployment_assumptions.scope: When an overlay remains paired with one engine and its stable weight/KV addresses, replay faithfully executes the canonical eager launch captured for the installed exact or padded metadata; graph_cover proves projection from padded pure-decode launches to the real step.

deployment_assumptions.name: qualified_kernel_plan_identity
deployment_assumptions.scope: Cross-trace determinism compares only executions carrying the same sealed deployment SHA-256 identity; no cross-configuration or cross-hardware kernel equivalence is claimed.
